method: Human-authorized ninth verification round for stage4 (Jaden, 2026-10-10: 'run a fresh independent verifier round for the behavior research stages'; re-sample after fixing mismatches; 2026-10-11: budget-friendly path approved). Before this round, the attempt-8 stage4 mismatch was fixed against the archived document: OHM-136's second open item now records the typical junction-to-free-air RthJA of 68 degC/W printed on page 14 instead of saying no thermal resistance is given. A read-only scan of all 78 stage4 entries for open items or conflicts that call something absent from a document that mentions it found no further cases. New integer seed drawn once with secrets.randbits(63) before the sample was computed. One fresh-context reviewer agent per sampled entry (Claude Sonnet, chosen for cost) with the unchanged round-7 instructions: text extraction with word coordinates first, at most four cropped renders at 150 dpi or less, and spot checks of digitized curve points instead of full re-digitization. Reviewers read only the entry gapfill, its generated record, FETCH_LEDGER.jsonl (URL-to-SHA256 mapping only) and the archived primary-source bytes; no web access, no other repository files, no prior verifier reports. Values, units, conditions, min/typ/max qualifiers, document metadata and provenance claims were re-derived; page-citation drift with the value present elsewhere in the same document is recorded as a note. Refresh after merging origin/main #59 and #63 (D075 pin-level bindings rewrote OHM-126 and OHM-131, both sampled entries): one new fresh-context reviewer per changed entry (Claude Sonnet, same instructions) re-reviewed it against its new gap-fill and record bytes under the same seed, population and sample. The other six results are unchanged because their reviewed gap-fill and record bytes are identical. The original attempt-9 report is kept as stage4-attempt9.json.
